component.name: SimuPy
component.summary: Block-diagram simulation with blocks written in Python

description.p: SimuPy is a block-diagram simulator in the spirit of Simulink. The engine, the editor and the solvers are C++; when a diagram needs behaviour no built-in block provides, you drop in a Python block and write it as a small class — no plugin to compile and no restart, since the script is recompiled at the start of every run.

ul.li: Continuous, discrete, routing, control and hardware blocks
Fixed and adaptive solvers, event location and algebraic loops
Subsystems with masks, and libraries of reusable custom blocks
Live scopes, interactive controls and real-time or unbounded runs
A command-line runner for batch simulation and CSV output
